_comment: The prefilled WhatsApp message in each language, written by Claude (via:claude) because
DeepL was out of quota; replace with a DeepL or owner version when one exists.
build-i18n.mjs fills {title} (the translated title), {price} (' (€24)' or nothing) and
{last} (the listing URL for ask, the reference for order and restock).
A language with no entry here keeps the English message from build-shop.mjs.

cs.ask: Dobrý den! Mám dotaz ke kousku „{title}“{price}: {last}

cs.sold: Dobrý den! Kousek „{title}“ je prodaný. Máte něco podobného?
cs.restock: Dobrý den! Bude „{title}“ zase skladem? Kód {last}
cs.hello: Dobrý den! Píšu z webu guldaarbazaar.com a mám dotaz.
